r13_contract.comparisonModel: If a ship is intended to operate astern in ice regions, the aft section of the ship is to be designed using the Bow and Bow Intermediate hull area requirements.

test_cases.rationale: Astern ice operation is intended and aft-section design uses Bow and Bow Intermediate requirements.
Astern ice operation is not intended; conditional obligation does not apply.
Astern operation is intended but aftSectionDesignBasis is incorrect.
Astern operation is intended but hullAreaRequirementSet is missing.
Astern operation is intended but aftSectionDesignBasis is missing.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
